hints.title: Equal Pair Invariant
hints.text: When a value with previous frequency c is appended, it forms c new matching pairs.

hints.title: Sliding Window Rightward Expansion
hints.text: Expand the right boundary, tracking total matching pairs until pairs >= k.

hints.title: Subarray Sufficiency Extension
hints.text: If window [left, right] is good, any subarray extending to indices right, right + 1, ..., n - 1 is also good.

hints.title: Sliding Window Good Subarray Counting Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def countGood(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        counts = Counter()
        pairs = 0
        left = 0
        ans = 0
        n = len(nums)
        for right, x in enumerate(nums):
            pairs += counts[x]
            counts[x] += 1
            while pairs >= k:
                ans += n - right
                counts[nums[left]] -= 1
                pairs -= counts[nums[left]]
                left += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Both left and right pointers traverse the array at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(n^2) subarrays takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for frequency hash map.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes monotonicity: once [left, right] has k pairs, all super-intervals ending at or after right are also good.
